-- intro: Union Magic: Sea God Slash is a song- and butoh-based Union Magic spell.
-- Description:
    With open grimoires, Song Magic is used to enhance Butoh Magic, and the magics combine to create large magical auras around the dancer's swords. When the dancer swings their swords, powerful shockwaves and flying slashes are produced. This spell is also a form of worshiping the Seabed Temple's Sea God.
